//ENHANCED: SINGLE SHOT VERSION

For single-shot weapons:
Scoring 3 hits with at least 1.2 seconds or at most 4 seconds between each other grants ? Reload Speed and #e<pve 6% /> <pvp [?] /> increased damage for 8 seconds.

Additional hits while the buff duration is below 4 seconds refresh the timer to 4 seconds.


For multi-shot weapons:
Scoring 3 hits with at least 0.8 seconds or at most 1.2 seconds between each other <title refills [G_refill] /> 10% of the magazine and grants #e<pve 6% /> <pvp [?] /> increased damage for 4 seconds.
